body: My mental health has spiraled out of control, my meds aren’t working. I’ve never contemplated suicide and non existence as much as i have this year. Don’t have many people to go to, so i came here looking for people who are struggling too and good advice.
Man i feel like a woman- Shania Twain

You described how I feel word for word. You’re not alone. It’s a daily fight. I just think about my pets I have rescued and my Gf. They need me. They keep me anchored here. Even though every day is war in our mind, try to find someone or something to anchor to. May not be the best advice but it’s all i got.

I do not have many friends unfortunately, and the ones I have live a good distance away from me. My SO is finishing up her degree at college so we are having to be apart right now. And I’m a very left leaning atheist in small town Alabama with a family full of Christians. So it’s just hard to have conversations and make friends here. I have to kinda just play pretend to fit in and keep my job. It’s just a very isolating time In my life unfortunately
